svg.text: Roof plan slices · grid A
horizontal cuts through the roof, looking down
Inner layer 1, 80 printed, room side, then layer 2
(printed, thinner towards the crown).
Air zone, open between the ribs, for insulation
(dotted).
Cast concrete cut by the plane (crossed hatch): the
ribs, columns of grid A, each 160 wide across the
rib and 240 deep (the cut is longer than 160 and
sheared where the rib is inclined in the face; 4 Ø16
and stirrups as in the rib section), and, at the
crown, the whole top ring.
Corner blocks: the four hip ribs, cut across the
corners (cast).
Outer layer 80, printed.
Insulation 100 (very thin line), then the outer
layer 30 (dark).
from your sketches
assumed by me, to confirm
Notes
Heights are levels from the ground floor. Large slice at
+8.50 (at the crown, 5999 above the eave), drawn at 1:20
so the top ring is readable, through the top ring; small
slices at +4.00 and +7.00, 1:100 (the scale bar is for
Option A: all columns at +4.00; at +7.00 every other
column has stopped (they stop once the spacing is 500); at
the crown only the four hip ribs and the top ring are
left. The middle horizontal ribs are at +4.31, +6.13 and
Layer 2 thins towards the crown (the leaf is 160 at the
base, 80 at the crown). Ribs use the same geometry as the
roof-grid sheets; bars and stirrups are assumed.
